en.tagline: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
en.summary: agent-browser is a command line tool that lets an AI agent control Chrome or Chromium. It covers navigating pages, filling forms, clicking, taking screenshots, and extracting data. It also includes specialized guides for Electron apps, Slack, QA testing, and cloud browser providers.
problem: An AI agent often needs to act on a website: log in, fill a form, click through a flow, or pull data from a page. Doing this reliably requires a way to read the page and point at specific elements.
With agent-browser, the agent reads accessibility-tree snapshots and targets elements by compact `@eN` refs. Sessions, state persistence, and an authentication vault let work continue across steps.
fit: Filling out and submitting web forms
Exploratory testing, QA, and bug hunts on a web app
Automating Electron desktop apps or Slack tasks
unfit: Tasks that do not involve a browser, Electron app, or Slack
Using the stub file alone as a usage guide, since it only points to the core guide
steps: Load the core guide with `agent-browser skills get core`, which covers the main loop, waits, common tasks, and troubleshooting.
Load a specialized guide, such as `electron`, `slack`, or `dogfood`, when the task falls outside ordinary web pages.
Open the target page and read its accessibility-tree snapshot.
Use the `@eN` element refs in the snapshot to click, fill, or read specific elements.
Repeat the loop, taking screenshots or extracting data as needed, until the task is done.

zh.tagline: 供 AI 代理使用的浏览器自动化 CLI
zh.summary: agent-browser 是一个命令行工具，让 AI 代理可以控制 Chrome 或 Chromium。它支持打开页面、填写表单、点击、截图和提取数据。它还附带针对 Electron 应用、Slack、QA 测试和云端浏览器服务的专门指南。
problem: AI 代理常常需要操作网站，例如登录、填写表单、完成一个操作流程，或从页面中提取数据。要稳定地完成这些操作，需要一种方式读取页面，并准确定位到具体元素。
使用 agent-browser 后，代理可以读取无障碍树快照，并通过简洁的 `@eN` 引用定位元素。会话、状态持久化和认证保险库让任务可以跨多个步骤连续进行。
fit: 对 Web 应用做探索性测试、QA 和缺陷排查
自动化 Electron 桌面应用或 Slack 相关任务
unfit: 不涉及浏览器、Electron 应用或 Slack 的任务
只依赖入口说明文件作为使用指南，因为它只指向核心指南
steps: 运行 `agent-browser skills get core` 加载核心指南，其中包括主要操作循环、等待、常见任务和故障排查。
当任务超出普通网页范围时，加载对应的专门指南，例如 `electron`、`slack` 或 `dogfood`。
打开目标页面，读取它的无障碍树快照。
使用快照中的 `@eN` 元素引用，点击、填写或读取特定元素。
根据需要重复这一循环，截图或提取数据，直到任务完成。
